note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described; the worker is dimorphic. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown; nasus light brown; antennae, legs and pronotum cream-coloured; abdominal tergites and sternites translucent, with grey intestinal contents visible. Head with a few microscopic setae; vertex with 1 pair of longer setae, 1 pair at the level of the antennae, and one or two additional pairs on the nasus; apex of the nasus with numerous microscopic setae and one or two pairs of longer setae; each abdominal tergite with a few short setae and a few long setae near the posterior margin, sternites more hairy. Body length 4.0–4.5 mm. Head broadly pear-shaped, wider than the length without nasus (length with nasus 1.70–1.80, length without nasus 0.98–1.05, maximum width 0.98–1.08 mm, width/length-without-nasus index 1.00–1.05); in lateral view depressed behind the nasus; nasus thick, conical. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2 and nearly equal to segment 5; segment 4 the shortest. Mandibles reduced, nodular, without lateral spine-like processes. Pronotum saddle-shaped; margins with microscopic setae and one or two long setae; anterior margin distinctly notched; posterior margin straight. Mesonotum narrower, metanotum slightly wider than the pronotum; posterior margins of both nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head pale yellow; thorax slightly paler than the head; antennae and legs cream-coloured; abdominal tergites and sternites translucent. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.3–4.4 mm. Head nearly square (length to the base of the mandibles 0.90–0.92, maximum width 1.0–1.05 mm). Fontanelle plate oval (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.07–0.075 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 the shortest. Postclypeus weakly swollen, hairy (length 0.18–0.19, width 0.50–0.53 mm); posterior margin concave in the middle, anterior margin slightly incurved. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but slightly smaller; body length 3.5–4.0, head length to the base of the mandibles 0.78–0.80, maximum head width 0.88–0.95 mm.
